summary: Obsidian Energy Ltd., a Calgary-based oil and gas producer listed in the US via a 6-K equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, filed two material credit agreements: a Second Amending Agreement to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, effective August 4, 2026, with Royal Bank of Canada, Bank of Montreal and ICBC Standard Bank PLC as lenders and RBC as agent, plus the underlying April 28, 2026 credit agreement. Amendments update definitions including 2025 Notes, referencing 8.125% senior unsecured notes due December 3, 2030. No special-situation terms are stated; watch covenant and borrowing-base changes.
